findings: Both new modules were read in full (199 and 177 lines), with original manuscript and actual production causal, quotient, prime-AP and harmonic supplier boundaries. The exact H/F arithmetic count, H actual-root and I finite-mean/physical-seed sources were inspected directly.

The receiver removes ALL primes dividing N. Inclusive prime labels ell<=N become the actual additive carrier through coprimality; this is not only exclusion of ell=N. It stays unchanged in every count, polynomial and descendant.

The masked d*N sifting equivalence is justified only with d z-rough and the actual quotient coprime to N. A hypothetical small divisor of the quotient is coprime to d by prefix roughness and to N by quotient coprimality, so it cannot be hidden by the mask. The actual original pair selector supplies the rough-prefix gate at N^a.

The original source-to-quotient map is injective on exact multiples, independently of desired cardinalities. This proves exact carrier and count identities. Unit quotients and repeated residual prime factors remain; no squarefree condition is imposed on the quotient being counted. Strict sifting keeps primes at the cutoff, the pair selector keeps its inclusive lower and strict upper bounds, and summation retains the original ordered-pair multiplicity.

The finite AP discrepancy uses the actual original prime carrier and exact coprime population. Complete modulus d*r is primitive because d is coprime to N and r divides P(d*N,z). Its true-li shift includes the modulus-prime loss. Combining AP and shift before recentering gives the precise sharp-prefix discrepancy, modulus-prime term and negative centre-prime AP term. Original-source mass cancellation prevents double payment of centre deletions.

All sharp-prefix identities retain the same signed Rosser weight. The combined identity itself does not need an extra coprimality premise; the actual-source finite-mean formula does and the root supplies it. No absolute value, arbitrary receiver distribution theorem, PNT replacement or AP estimate is inserted.

The real enhanced max-level V is retained. Actual logarithmic prime coordinates give Q/d=N^L with L>=34/125, s=L/a in [2,5], and (Q/d)^(1/s)=N^a. The original dictionary also supplies the selected/full cutoff squares and alpha>=2. The residual floor does not replace Q by a smaller common root.

A nonzero initial Rosser coefficient has r<floor(Q/d)+1 and r dividing P(d*N,N^a). Hence r<=Q/d and d*r<=Q<=N^(153/256). Coprimality to d*N plus the original pair coprimality gives (d*r,N)=1. This is the complete modulus, not just the residual divisor r.

The initial squarefree gate is justified at source level: P(d*N,N^a) is a product of distinct allowed primes, hence r is squarefree; the original pair contains distinct primes p<q, so d is squarefree; and r is coprime to d. Thus d*r is squarefree. The new root_seed_coefficient_support theorem explicitly concludes the cap and primitive residue; it does not itself state this squarefree consequence. The inspected Rosser coefficient has absolute value at most one per pair. No aggregate coefficient norm or physical W/PP licence follows from these initial facts.

The canonical lower/upper density suppliers were read in the actual pinned WSL source. Their threshold precedes every N,d and carrier depth, uses the genuine localSieveProduct(d*N,z), and covers lower s in [2,10] and upper s in [3/2,10]. I supplies a uniform physical-cutoff threshold from N^nu<=Q/d and s<=10, then multiplies by nonnegative li(N)/phi(d). The true signed AP and mean errors remain.

The H arithmetic state is initialized by the actual finite Rosser polynomials. Ordinary candidates and all70 W1 candidates read only the preceding generation; every child keeps the same Q and frozen E, and its query is admitted by a genuine full-square gate. Positive switched rawTripleCount terms remain literal counts. Induction proves enclosure, and fallback min/max preserves the initial bounds. No caller-supplied Sound invariant, positive defect or desired lower count is assumed.

Consequently for every eta>0 one N0>=4 precedes even N, every original pair, every finite bank and every number of rounds. The actual seed-plus-error, lower state, exact U5 fibre, upper state and upper seed-plus-error form the claimed chain. Summing over the entire original selector yields the exact U5 aggregate inequality.

Q varies between original prime pairs while remaining fixed within each arithmetic recursion. This does not produce a common-Q marked analytic family or convert the manuscript's averaged H/h defects into pointwise estimates. Existing adopted-h248 harmonic transport is a different source theorem; it supplies neither raw-count/h248 identification nor the savedL5 arithmetic supplier.

The prior I fresh third-W receiver subfamily and H strict tent work retain their narrow boundaries. Their source pins and reports do not license the whole original mixed W/tent policy, the same production causal rho, selected histories, moving residues, or enhanced distribution.
